notes:
— Account: Celestia TicketCraft (headless commerce platform, EU HQ).
— Use-case: automated ticket/email summarization + adaptive auto-tagging -> feed Zendesk macros / triggers; agent assist snippets; reduce TTR and tagging errors.
— Volume/scale: ~6k tickets/day current, peak spikes up to 1200 concurrent incoming messages during promos. Want graceful degradation: fallback to lightweight summarizer + queueing, not 503.
— Latency targets: median <200ms for short summaries (<=150 tokens), p95 <800ms. Throughput target: 1000 reqs/min sustained during promos.
— Cost sensitivity: medium — will trade some latency for lower per-token cost on non-critical routes. Interested in quantized model variants for background summarization.
— Models: prefer open-models for auditability but want Redwood-verified profiles; interested in model routing (fast small model for short tickets, larger for complex cases) + automatic fallback.
— Integrations: Zendesk (primary), Freshdesk considered for smaller brands; needs macros injection, trigger updates, and webhook retry semantics.
— Security: EU data residency required for pilot; DPA and subprocessor list requested. SSO via SAML mandatory. KMS for keys. Audit logs + retention policy (90/365) required.
— POC success criteria: >30% reduction in avg handle time for tickets with AI-suggested summaries, 85% precision on top-3 suggested tags, no security objections from legal.
— Quote from Head of Support: "We need concise one-line summaries and consistent tags — agents should be able to copy+paste in one click."
— Recent tech note: SAML flow failing when ACS URL contains staging subdomain; Diego debugging with engineering.
— Suggested Redwood config: dedicated pool for summarization endpoints with autoscaling for promo windows; prefix/KV caching for repeated threads; fallbacks to smaller quantized variant.
— Risks: on-prem package for EU could push timeline 6-8 weeks; legal sign-off on DPA could delay close.
— Commercial: RM asked for 12-month committed capacity pricing; trial expected to convert if POC metrics hit.
— Next: legal to share redlined DPA (ticket RDW-9123), schedule SAML test with infra on 2025-03-18.
